observations: The adjacent front tile must be native/rewritten high ground or a blocking object; the next front tile must pass ground units.

Measure the central landing tile and its left/right passable neighbours, within three cells. Place five grenades from the right edge toward the left, separated by one quarter of the available width and half a second between emissions.
Each grenade explodes after roughly two seconds, within radius 1.2, and cannot hit airborne enemies. Owner departure preserves only already placed grenades.
The shield blocks Physical damage from sources whose enemy attack classification includes ranged.
limits: These authored observations corroborate geometry and lifecycle, not compiled Unity execution.
Native delayAfterReached is about 1.8 seconds; flight origin, movement, stop dispatch and current-source statistics need explicit local execution contracts.
Exact boundary placement, dynamic obstacle classification, animation callback priority, modules and original VFX/audio remain unverified.
